      public String generateHidato(String topology, String adja, String dif, int nC)
      It communicates with the domain DomainController to generate a valid hidato based on the paramether difficulty.
      Parameters:
      topology - "Squares", "Triangles", "Hexagons"
      adja - "Sides", "Sides + Vertices"
      dif - Difficulty: "EASY", "MEDIUM", "HARD"
      nC - integer representing the number of cells of the hidato to generate
      Returns:

    • startSolving

      public void startSolving(String difficulty, boolean isRanked)
      Inside PlayCasual or PlayRanked modes, when the user presses the "Start Solving" button this function is triggered to communicate with the domain DomainController and generate an hidato. Also, the view is from the class ViewHidatoSolving.
      Parameters:
      difficulty - The hidato is generated using a difficulty paramether. This impacts the initial % of solved cells and its number.

    • machineSolve

      public void machineSolve(String baseHidato, boolean isRanked)
      It creates a new ViewHidatoSolving with the baseHidato solved.
      Parameters:
      baseHidato - String representing the unsolved original hidato.
      isRanked - Boolean to know where to go if button Back is pressed.
